1.firered: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this POKéMON is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
1.leafgreen: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

2.firered: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
2.leafgreen: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

3.firered: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
3.leafgreen: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

4.firered: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
4.leafgreen: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

5.firered: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.
5.leafgreen: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

6.firered: Its wings can carry this POKéMON close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
6.leafgreen: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

7.firered: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.
7.leafgreen: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

8.firered: This POKéMON is very popular as a pet. Its fur-covered tail is a symbol of its longevity.
8.leafgreen: It often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For fast swimming, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

9.firered: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
9.leafgreen: The pressurized water jets on this brutal POKéMON’s shell are used for high- speed tackles.

10.firered: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.
10.leafgreen: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

11.firered: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
11.leafgreen: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

12.firered: The wings are protected by rain-repellent dust. As a result, this POKéMON can fly about even in rain.
12.leafgreen: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

13.firered: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.
13.leafgreen: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp stinger on its head that injects poison.

14.firered: This POKéMON is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.
14.leafgreen: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.

15.firered: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
15.leafgreen: It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

16.firered: Does not like to fight. It hides in tall grass and so on, foraging for food such as small bugs.
16.leafgreen: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

17.firered: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an EXEGGCUTE to its nest over 60 miles away.
17.leafgreen: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

18.firered: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.
18.leafgreen: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

19.firered: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.
19.leafgreen: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

20.firered: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.
20.leafgreen: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

21.firered: It busily flits around here and there. Even if it is frail, it can be a tough foe that uses MIRROR MOVE.
21.leafgreen: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

22.firered: Its huge and magnificent wings can keep it aloft in the sky. It can remain flying a whole day without landing.
22.leafgreen: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

23.firered: A very common sight in grassland, etc. It flicks its tongue in and out to sense danger in its surroundings.
23.leafgreen: Moving silently and stealthily, it eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

24.firered: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
24.leafgreen: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

25.firered: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
25.leafgreen: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

26.firered: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.
26.leafgreen: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

27.firered: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
27.leafgreen: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for prey.

28.firered: It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.
28.leafgreen: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

29.firered: Though small, it must be treated with caution because of its powerfully toxic barbs. The female has smaller horns.
29.leafgreen: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

30.firered: The female has a gentle temperament. It emits ultrasonic cries that have the power to befuddle foes.
30.leafgreen: The female’s horns develop slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

31.firered: The body is covered by stiff, needle- like scales. If it becomes excited, the needles bristle outwards.
31.leafgreen: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

32.firered: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.
32.leafgreen: It stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

33.firered: It is easily angered. By swinging its well- developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.
33.leafgreen: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

34.firered: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.
34.leafgreen: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey’s bones.

35.firered: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.
35.leafgreen: With its magical and cute appeal, it has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

36.firered: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
36.leafgreen: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

37.firered: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
37.leafgreen: When it is born, it has just one snow- white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

38.firered: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
38.leafgreen: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

39.firered: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.
39.leafgreen: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

40.firered: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.
40.leafgreen: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

41.firered: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
41.leafgreen: It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

42.firered: It clamps down on its prey with needle- sharp fangs and drains over 10 ounces of blood in one gulp.
42.leafgreen: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

43.firered: Its scientific name is “Oddium Wanderus.” At night, it is said to walk nearly 1,000 feet on its two roots.
43.leafgreen: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

44.firered: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
44.leafgreen: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

45.firered: Its petals are the largest in the world. It fiendishly scatters allergy-causing pollen from its petals.
45.leafgreen: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

46.firered: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.
46.leafgreen: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

47.firered: It scatters toxic spores from the mushroom cap. In China, the spores are used as herbal medicine.
47.leafgreen: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

48.firered: Its eyes act as radar, enabling it to be active in darkness. The eyes can also shoot powerful beams.
48.leafgreen: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

49.firered: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
49.leafgreen: The dustlike scales covering its wings are color-coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

50.firered: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
50.leafgreen: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

51.firered: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
51.leafgreen: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

52.firered: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
52.leafgreen: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

53.firered: Has a vicious temperament. Beware if it raises its tail straight up. It is a signal that it is about to pounce and bite.
53.leafgreen: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

54.firered: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
54.leafgreen: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

55.firered: The forelegs are webbed, helping to make it an adept swimmer. It can be seen swimming elegantly in lakes, etc.
55.leafgreen: Often seen swimming elegantly by lakeshores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster Kappa.

56.firered: Light and agile on its feet, and ferocious in temperament. When angered, it flies into an uncontrollable frenzy.
56.leafgreen: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

57.firered: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.
57.leafgreen: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it catches up.

58.firered: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
58.leafgreen: It is very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

59.firered: A POKéMON that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.
59.leafgreen: A POKéMON that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

60.firered: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.
60.leafgreen: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

61.firered: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.
61.leafgreen: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

62.firered: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.
62.leafgreen: A swimmer adept at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

63.firered: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
63.leafgreen: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

64.firered: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into KADABRA.
64.leafgreen: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.

65.firered: It does not like physical attacks very much. Instead, it freely uses extra sensory powers to defeat foes.
65.leafgreen: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its IQ (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.

66.firered: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it’s the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
66.leafgreen: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

67.firered: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
67.leafgreen: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

68.firered: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.
68.leafgreen: Its superpowerful punches are said to knock the victim flying clear over the horizon.

69.firered: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
69.leafgreen: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It appears to use its root feet to replenish moisture.

70.firered: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
70.leafgreen: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

71.firered: Lures prey into its mouth with a honeylike aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a dissolving fluid.
71.leafgreen: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

72.firered: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
72.leafgreen: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.

73.firered: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
73.leafgreen: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

74.firered: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
74.leafgreen: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

75.firered: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. GRAVELER may come rolling down the path without slowing.
75.leafgreen: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

76.firered: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
76.leafgreen: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.

77.firered: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.
77.leafgreen: Its hooves are ten times harder than diamond. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

78.firered: It can gallop at a top speed of 150 miles per hour. It can race as fast as a bullet train while ablaze.
78.leafgreen: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

79.firered: It is always vacantly lost in thought, but no one knows what it is thinking about. It is good at fishing with its tail.
79.leafgreen: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

80.firered: When a SLOWPOKE went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a SHELLDER. That made it evolve into SLOWBRO.
80.leafgreen: The SHELLDER that latches onto SLOWPOKE’s tail is said to feed on the host’s leftover scraps.

81.firered: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges THUNDER WAVE and so on from the units at its sides.
81.leafgreen: Uses antigravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

82.firered: A linked cluster formed of several MAGNEMITE. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.
82.leafgreen: Formed by several MAGNEMITE linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

83.firered: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.
83.leafgreen: The plant stalk it holds is its weapon. The stalk is used like a sword to cut all sorts of things.

84.firered: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
84.leafgreen: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

85.firered: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
85.leafgreen: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head is said to stay awake.

86.firered: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of minus 40 degrees Fahrenheit.
86.leafgreen: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick icebergs.

87.firered: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.
87.leafgreen: It stores thermal energy in the body. It swims at a steady eight knots even in intensely cold waters.

88.firered: Sludge exposed to X rays from the moon transformed into GRIMER. It loves feeding on filthy things.
88.leafgreen: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

89.firered: It is usually undetectable because it blends in with the ground. Touching it can cause terrible poisoning.
89.leafgreen: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

90.firered: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
90.leafgreen: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

91.firered: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
91.leafgreen: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

92.firered: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.
92.leafgreen: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

93.firered: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, HAUNTER is there.
93.leafgreen: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

94.firered: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
94.leafgreen: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be GENGAR’s doing.

95.firered: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
95.leafgreen: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to black-colored diamonds.

96.firered: A descendent of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.
96.leafgreen: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

97.firered: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.
97.leafgreen: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

98.firered: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
98.leafgreen: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

99.firered: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000- horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
99.leafgreen: The large pincer has 10,000-horsepower crushing force. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

100.firered: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to SCREECH or suddenly SELFDESTRUCT.
100.leafgreen: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, it has zapped many people.

101.firered: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of “The Bomb Ball.”
101.leafgreen: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

102.firered: Even though it appears to be eggs of some sort, it was discovered to be a life- form more like plant seeds.
102.leafgreen: It is often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

103.firered: It is called “The Walking Tropical Rainforest.” Each of the nuts has a face and a will of its own.
103.leafgreen: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

104.firered: It wears the skull of its dead mother on its head. When it becomes lonesome, it is said to cry loudly.
104.leafgreen: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON’s real face.

105.firered: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
105.leafgreen: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

106.firered: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
106.leafgreen: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra-long, loping strides.

107.firered: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.
107.leafgreen: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

108.firered: Its tongue is twice the length of its body. It can be moved like an arm for grabbing food and attacking.
108.leafgreen: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon’s. It leaves a tingling sensation when it licks enemies.

109.firered: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
109.leafgreen: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

110.firered: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small KOFFING twins becoming conjoined as a WEEZING.
110.leafgreen: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFING can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

111.firered: Strong, but not too bright, this POKéMON can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging TACKLES.
111.leafgreen: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. Its TACKLE can knock a semitrailer flying.

112.firered: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
112.leafgreen: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

113.firered: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.
113.leafgreen: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch one.

114.firered: Blue plant vines cloak the POKéMON’s identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.
114.leafgreen: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. The vines sway as it walks.

115.firered: The female raises its offspring in a pouch on its belly. It is skilled at attacking using COMET PUNCH.
115.leafgreen: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother’s protective pouch until it is three years old.

116.firered: It maintains balance using its tail, which is wound up like a coil. It may spray ink from its mouth.
116.leafgreen: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

117.firered: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
117.leafgreen: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

118.firered: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
118.leafgreen: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of “The Water Queen.”

119.firered: The horn on its head is sharp like a drill. It bores a hole in a boulder to make its nest.
119.leafgreen: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

120.firered: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.
120.leafgreen: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

121.firered: This POKéMON has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.
121.leafgreen: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

122.firered: It is adept at conning people. It is said to be able to create walls out of thin air by miming.
122.leafgreen: If interrupted while it is miming, it will suddenly DOUBLESLAP the offender with its broad hands.

123.firered: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.
123.leafgreen: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of itself.

124.firered: It speaks using a language that sounds human. Research is under way to determine what is being said.
124.leafgreen: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

125.firered: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.
125.leafgreen: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

126.firered: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.
126.leafgreen: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly amidst flames.

127.firered: Its two long pincer horns are powerful. Once they grip an enemy, they won’t release until the foe is torn.
127.leafgreen: If it fails to crush the foe in its pincers, it will swing around and toss the opponent.

128.firered: When it is about to TACKLE, it whips its body repeatedly with its three long tails.
128.leafgreen: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

129.firered: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic POKéMON in the world.
129.leafgreen: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

130.firered: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The HYPER BEAM it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
130.leafgreen: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

131.firered: Its high intelligence enables it to understand human speech. It likes to ferry people on its back.
131.leafgreen: A POKéMON that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people on its back.

132.firered: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life- forms.
132.leafgreen: Capable of copying an opponent’s genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

133.firered: An extremely rare POKéMON that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
133.leafgreen: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONES.

134.firered: Its body’s cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.
134.leafgreen: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

135.firered: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
135.leafgreen: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

136.firered: It has a flame bag inside its body. After inhaling deeply, it blows out flames of nearly 3,100 degrees Fahrenheit.
